issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent behavioral break.
issues.detail: Existing callers using InputParams() will silently switch endpointing modes on upgrade, changing VAD emission and finalization triggers. The changelog files this as a 'fix' but it is a breaking default change. Either retain EXTERNAL as the default, add a deprecation/transitional warning, or call out the migration explicitly in the changelog.

issues.description: _enable_vad invariant is unstated and couples two enums without specification.
issues.detail: _enable_vad is now False for both FIXED and EXTERNAL EndOfUtteranceMode, and its derivation implicitly couples TurnDetectionMode and EndOfUtteranceMode. The name suggests 'VAD is enabled' but the semantic is 'this plugin emits VAD frames.' Document the invariant at the class boundary, or unify the enums.

issues.description: Frame-handler swap to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame narrows the accepted supertype contract.
issues.detail: process_frame now only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, so callers wiring non-VAD producers of UserStoppedSpeakingFrame will silently lose finalization. Either accept both frame types, document the stricter precondition at the supertype level, or add an inline comment explaining the rationale so the next reader doesn't invert the predicate.

issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED referenced without visible import or proof of SDK availability.
issues.detail: _enable_vad checks EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED but the diff shows no new import or enum addition. If the speechmatics SDK 0.0.99 didn't add this value, construction raises AttributeError. The PR should include evidence (test run, import diff) that this resolves at runtime.

issues.description: Docstrings for turn_detection_mode are inconsistent and don't describe FIXED vs EXTERNAL contracts.
issues.detail: Surrounding prose still frames EXTERNAL as Pipecat-controlled while FIXED is now the default, leaving the reader unable to tell what guarantees each mode provides. Add a one-paragraph contract per mode clarifying who drives endpointing and what frames are emitted.

issues.description: split_sentences wiring is double-written and unconditionally clobbers the vendor default.
issues.detail: split_sentences is forwarded through the generic keys loop and then overwritten by a dedicated SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False) assignment. This double-write is confusing, the `or False` coercion obscures intent for a bool|None field, and the unconditional replacement silently overrides any upstream default when the user didn't opt in.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. The dominant concern is a silent contract change: the default turn_detection_mode flips from EXTERNAL to FIXED, and process_frame narrows finalization to VAD-origin stop frames — both observable behavior changes for existing callers without a migration path. The _enable_vad predicate now spans two enums with no stated invariant, and EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED is referenced without visible import evidence. Documentation lags the code (FIXED vs EXTERNAL contracts are unclear), and the split_sentences wiring is double-written while clobbering vendor defaults. Recommend documenting the new contracts, verifying the SDK import, and tightening the split_sentences path.
